description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Older name for co_invent_read, kept so a connector with a saved tool list keeps working. Read any part of a pass, as a person reads it in the app. part: list (what's there), brief, shortlist, concept, brainstorm, review, mustdos, requirements, spec, bom, risks, business, market, engineering, diagrams, patent, claimcheck, rounds, app, checks, provenance or activity; export gives the whole package as one JSON; pack gives the private links to the finished package for its owner.
name: co_invent_pass_read
